def make_magic(n):
    a = [[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
    r, c = 0, n//2
    for value in range(1,n*n+1):
        a[r][c] = value
        nr, nc = (r-1)%n, (c+1)%n
        if a[nr][nc]: r = (r+1)%n
        else: r,c = nr,nc
    return a

steps.text: Set a to a list of [0] * n for _ in range(n).
Process each value in range(1, n * n + 1).
Check whether a[nr][nc]. Set r to (r + 1) % n.
